about: The complete corresponding source of the ffmpeg the macOS app ships (scripts/lib/ffmpeg-mac-pin.json): FFmpeg, the build scripts at the revision that built it, and every library linked into it, each pinned by SHA-256. scripts/build-ffmpeg-source-bundle.mjs downloads each file, refuses any whose hash differs, and packs them into one release asset. Change it together with the pin.

ffmpeg.note: The build script downloads ffmpeg-9.0.2.tar.bz2; this is the same FFmpeg release in its .tar.xz form, signed by the FFmpeg developers (signature at the same address with .asc added).

buildScript.evidence: Martin Riedl publishes no build log naming the revision. This commit ("chore: ffmpeg (version 9.0.2)", 18:00 CEST) is the head of develop when build 1789931890 was made (21:18 CEST the same day); the next commit on develop is from 2026-09-24. Every library version in its version/ folder equals the published versions.txt for this build, and its parent differs only in the FFmpeg version (9.0.1). main was still at 9.0.1 then. Checked 2026-10-09; the archive is byte-for-byte the commit's tree.

libraries.name: rav1e
libraries.note: Rust; built with cargo cinstall. The Rust crates it is built from are in rustCrates, pinned by the checksums in this Cargo.lock.

libraries.name: x264
libraries.note: The build script downloads the x264 master branch, which is not a fixed address. 0480cb05fa188d37ae87e8f4fd8f1aea3711f7ee (2025-09-10) was the head of master on 2026-09-20 and still is on 2026-10-09, so it is the commit this build used; the archive's own header names that commit.

libraries.name: libtheora
libraries.note: The build script uses plain http; the same file is fetched over https here.

rustCrates.note: Every crate in rav1e 0.8.1's Cargo.lock (a superset of what the static library links), with the SHA-256 the lock file records.

notIncluded.name: nasm 3.02, ninja 1.13.2, pkg-config 0.29.2, cmake 4.0.3, meson
notIncluded.why: build tools the script runs; nothing of them is in the binary

notIncluded.name: SDL 2.32.10
notIncluded.why: built by the script for ffplay only; the ffmpeg binary does not link it

notIncluded.name: libiconv, bzip2, CoreFoundation and the other macOS libraries
notIncluded.why: system libraries of macOS; the binary links them dynamically from the system
